title: Strategy Problem or Trader Problem?

launchpad.outcome: Run the diagnostic in order: method, selection, risk, management, then the larger valid sample.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What does the evidence point to?

slides.title: Rough week
lines: Did it? 😂 Let’s investigate, in order.
steps: Did you follow the method? (PIL · I-C-C · retest · entry)
Did you take the setups your plan actually allows?
Only then: what does the larger valid sample show?

slides.title: A rough week (practice dataset)
lines: 20 executed reps from a practice week. Not your data.
slides.q: Current evidence points most strongly toward…

slides.title: Your own data
lines: Same diagnostic, your journal. If there isn’t enough, it says so.
slides.principle: DON’T CHANGE THE STRATEGY TO SOLVE A BEHAVIOR PROBLEM.

takeaways: Investigate execution, selection, risk and management before the strategy.
remember: Don’t change the strategy to solve a behavior problem.
